question: Filter the BAM file to keep only reads with a mapping quality of 30 or above.

files.eval_guideline: Read records must match the reference; BAM header and optional-tag order may differ.
files.match_reasoning: Both files are named example_tumor_filtered.bam and are BAM files. That fits the task of filtering example_tumor.bam by MAPQ ≥ 30.
files.strategy_reasoning: MAPQ filtering always gives the same result, and the guideline asks for a read-by-read match while allowing the header and optional-tag order to differ. A bit-identical (exact) check could fail on those allowed differences, so this matches reads by name instead, with a strict overlap threshold. min_mapq is set to 0 so that wrongly kept reads below MAPQ 30 are still compared and flagged.
